text:
maria: Hey infra team — need an ephemeral burst pool for a performance run next week. Requesting H100 GPUs in europe-west4, 24 preemptible H100s for 6 hours at peak (can scale up to 48 if quota allows). Also want an L4 fallback pool (10 nodes) in the same region in case H100 availability is tight.

maria: Details below, please advise on what approvals we need and whether network/NAT capacity is fine for ~24 outbound-heavy instances.

maria: ```Project: redwood-staging-2026
Region: europe-west4
Quota changes requested:
  - GPUs (h100): 24 -> 48 (preemptible)
  - GPUs (l4): 0 -> 10 (preemptible, fallback)
Reason: dedicated autoscaler / burst load validation for Dedicated product (throughput / cold start tests)
Requested start: 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z
Duration: 6 hours peak, with autoscale window before/after
Contact: maria@redwood.com
Billing account: redwood-prod-billing
Notes: will use instance templates with cloud-init, images pre-warmed, strict TTL on ephemeral disks
```

sam: +1 on the request, but we need a rough cost estimate for finance sign-off. Do we have preemptible pricing for H100 in eu-west4?

leo: I can run numbers. Estimate: H100 preemptible ~ $X/hr (depends on region) — I'll ping pricing API and post a spreadsheet. We should also request additional Cloud NAT ephemeral ports if outbound connections > 200 concurrent per VM.

julie: Also confirm service account permissions. The pool will need iam.serviceAccountUser on the pool-sa and compute.instanceAdmin on the project. We should open a short IAM change RFC.

infra-bot: Created ticket GCP-QUOTA-2087: https://ticket.internal.redwood/GCP-QUOTA-2087 — "ephemeral h100 burst pool - europe-west4". Assigned to @leo.

leo: @maria can you confirm the CIDR/subnet? If we bring up 48 preemptibles, we'll need enough internal IPs and ensure the subnets have no secondary range collisions for Pod IPs.

maria: We'll use vpc-redwood-staging-subnet-a (10.40.16.0/20). No k8s secondary ranges on that subnet. All instances will NAT through the staging-nat gateway.

cloud-ops: Heads up — staging-nat currently has 5000 ephemeral ports available, but per-NAT-gateway throughput may need a second Nat or scaling to avoid SNAT conflicts. Recommend we request an increase in the NAT ephemeral port pool or provision a second NAT gateway for the test window.

maria: Noted. If we provision a second NAT gateway just for the 6hr burst, who needs to approve? Cost is small compared to GPU run but we should track it.

finance-bot: Please attach a short cost estimate (expected run hours x instance price) and tag with billing_code: ENG-BURST-03. Finance will triage within 24h.

sam: If we can use preemptible H100, it's usually 60-70% cheaper vs on-demand. Also suggest we put autoscaler to keep a minimum of 6 H100s so the test ramps without cold-starting everything at once.

leo: I uploaded a quick calc: https://docs.internal.redwood/sheets/h100-burst-estimate (shared with finance). Rough number: ~N USD for 24 H100s for 6h including egress & NAT overhead.

julie: IAM RFC: I'll draft a one-pager about the pool-sa and temporary role binding window. Will post in #eng-infra for approvals.

maria: TL;DR: GCP quota request created. Action items: (1) leo: finalize quota request and attach cost sheet to GCP-QUOTA-2087, (2) julie: post IAM RFC, (3) cloud-ops: advise NAT scaling plan and request ephemeral port increase, (4) finance-bot: sign off on cost. After finance ok we kick off the GCP quota change and schedule the run.

leo: Working on it now. @finance-bot can you pre-approve up to the estimate? If final is within 20% of the sheet, we proceed.

finance-bot: Pre-approval granted up to the estimate in the sheet. Final approval required after actual run. Tagging @julie for cost center confirmation. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: GCP-QUOTA-2087 updated: "Cost sheet attached; NAT capacity flagged; IAM RFC pending."

maria: Thanks. If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow I'll schedule the request for March 25 test window. :rocket:

cloud-ops: No objections from ops. I'll create a quick runbook for provisioning the second NAT and cleaning it up after the window.

julie: IAM RFC posted: https://docs.internal.redwood/rfcs/iam-ephemeral-pool.please-review — requesting @security to eyeball it.

sam: Great. Keep the thread updated if GCP responds with regional constraints. H100 stock can be flaky in eu-west4; backup plan is to failover to us-central1 or use the L4 fallback pool.

maria: Will do. Thanks all.
